# truenas_lxc_config (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS LXC service configuration. Takes no arguments: there is exactly one LXC configuration per TrueNAS system. Requires TrueNAS 26.0 or later (see the truenas_lxc_config resource's schema description for the version-gate details).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `bridge` (String) Network bridge interface used for LXC instance networking, or null if not configured (managed/created automatically).
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "lxc_config".
- `preferred_pool` (String) ZFS storage pool backing LXC-based instances and image datasets, or null if not configured.
- `v4_network` (String) IPv4 network CIDR for the LXC instance bridge network.
- `v6_network` (String) IPv6 network CIDR for the LXC instance bridge network.
